name: video-blur-vignette
title: Video Blur Vignette
blurb: Video with blur and vignette edges creating soft frame effect.
description: An autoplay video wrapped in a BlurVignette component that applies blurred, soft edges with vignetting effect. Creates elegant framed appearance around video content.
use_when: Hero sections or featured content needing soft, vignetted video framing effects.
avoid_when: When custom video sources are needed; this is a hardcoded demo with fixed video URL.
a11y: Autoplay video without captions or transcript; vignette effect is decorative.
